questions.question:
Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.

I can't pitcure him figting or picking on anyone.

options.text: I can't picture him fighting or picking on anyone.
I can't pitcure him fiting or piking on anyone.
I can't pitcure him fighting or pekking on anyone.
I can't pictre him fighting or pickning on anyone.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **I can't picture him fighting or picking on anyone.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The only word which is spelled incorrectly in the given sentence is: Fighting
 
• The word Fighting means 'an occasion when people fight (**लड़ाई-झगड़ा**)'.
 
 
• Example:* There has been street **fighting** in many parts of the city today.*
 
• **Synonyms: **battle, clash, combat, etc.
 
• **Antonyms: **concord, harmony, agreement, etc.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct sentence would be:* I can't picture him fighting or picking on anyone.*

 

Hence, option 1 is the correct choice.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

Why __doesn't you try__ calling your family again?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **don't you try**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Both** don't **and **doesn't** are contractions and they both act as auxiliary verbs in a sentence.
 
• We use, **don't** in a sentence when speaking in the:
 
 
• first and second person **plural and singular**; and
 
• the **third person plural** ("I," "you," "we," and "they").
 
 
 
• In the above sentence the **third person plural **(you) is used hence, **don't **would be used instead of **doesn't**.
 
• Hence, the complete sentence would be, *Why **don't you try **calling your family again?__*

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 3).*

questions.question:

The telecom growth story is a important component of the broader story of India.
questions.solution:

__
 
• In the sentence given above the use of article '**a**' is incorrect.
 
• The article '**an**' should be used in place of '**a**'.
 
• Use of article '**an**': before a **noun starting with a vowel sound**. 
 
 
• **Ex: **an hour, an ear, an umbrella, etc.
 
 
 
• In the above sentence, **an important component **should be used.
 
• Hence, the complete sentence would be, The telecom growth story is **an important component** of the broader story of India.__

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 4).*

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Solar storms can / impact Earth-dwellers / in significantly ways.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** in significantly ways**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect part of the sentence is **in significantly ways**.
 
• **Significant** (adjective) should be used instead of **significantly** (adverb).
 
 
• Significant (adjective): important or large enough to be noticed (**महत्वपूर्ण, काफ़ी बड़ा**) 
 
 
• ​Ex: Police said that the time of the murder was extremely **significant**.
 
 
 
• Significantly (adverb): in a significant manner (**सार्थक रूप से**)
 
 
• ​Ex: Attitudes have changed **significantly** since the 1960s.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct sentence would be, 
 
 
• *Solar storms can impact Earth-dwellers **in significant ways**__.*
 
 

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 1).*
